notes: Lots: every card in a lot gets a Benchmark price on its own (the lot pricing pass now actually runs, on finishing a lot and on reopening one with unpriced cards). Open a card inside a lot to scan a chip onto it and edit its price right there. The Benchmark column on the Lots page lines up. Chips: the UID field starts blank on every card and only fills on a fresh tap. Chip writes read the tag directly and fail fast with a plain message instead of freezing, a garbled tag number is never used, and a stuck reader call no longer blocks the next write. A chip tap in Stream Mode no longer shoves the app window down. Pricing: Inventory's Refresh pricing shows the fresh Benchmark on the card immediately, like the Benchmark Pricing page. On cheap cards the cheapest listing counts without shipping, matching the cloud. Sealed cards gain their cloud pricing lane (eBay sealed sales only) once the worker updates. Cards: an eBay sold-search link sits beside the TCGplayer link on every card's panel. A photo you put on a reverse holo or stamped card also updates the shared catalog. The show's card art downloads work (they no longer fail on the picture site's permissions).
